recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the FHIR-48309 clarification while preserving later FHIR-51645 endpoint wording; no separate core follow-up is needed for this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-48309 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for ImagingSelection.endpoint. It requested clarification of the endpoint detailed description by pointing readers to the endpoint notes section and adding comments describing typical DICOM endpoint types.
initial_application: FHIR-47991 added the ImagingSelection endpoint notes, and PR 3527/d5ac86f739918943a3204eb3b21f2dbda96d079a was cited on FHIR-48309. However, the current StructureDefinition source still had an unlinked "implementation notes" sentence and no DICOM WADO-RS/WADO-URI comment on ImagingSelection.endpoint.
additional_context: ImagingSelection is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/imagingselection/structuredefinition-ImagingSelection.xml is in current build scope. Later FHIR-51645 work changed the endpoint short display to broader access/subset wording, so the reconciliation preserved that later wording instead of restoring older retrieval-only text. FHIR-44974 is related because it earlier touched the same endpoint detailed-description fields, but it also covers other ImagingSelection elements and was not decided here.
reconciliation: Updated the ImagingSelection.endpoint definition to link directly to imagingselection.html#endpoints and added the approved comment describing DICOM WADO-RS and WADO-URI endpoint types. No generated diagram files were edited.
